en.headline: Disciplinary hearings for Wang Fuk Court fire contractors postponed
en.dek: The Fire Services Department said the Registered Fire Service Installation Contractors Disciplinary Board has deferred the hearings against two companies linked to the Tai Po blaze.
body: The Fire Services Department announced on Monday evening that disciplinary hearings scheduled for Friday against two fire-service installation contractors connected with the Wang Fuk Court fire in Tai Po have been postponed indefinitely.

The board accepted applications from both sides in the case of Victory Fire Engineering Company Limited so that further preparation could take place. Separately, the hearing concerning China Status Development and Engineering Company Limited was also deferred after the prosecution requested more time and the contractor did not object.

Independent inquiry hearings have previously heard that one contractor filed shutdown notices without attending the estate and that the other knew a fire-pump master switch had been turned off but did not report it. The department said the postponements would allow both sides additional preparation time.

zh.headline: 宏福苑兩消防承辦商紀律聆訊押後至另行通知
zh.dek: 消防處公布，原定周五就宏福苑大火兩間涉事消防裝置承辦商進行的紀律聆訊已獲委員會接納押後。
body: 消防處周一晚公布，註冊消防裝置承辦商紀律委員會原定本周五就宏福苑大火兩間涉事承辦商「宏泰消防工程有限公司」及「中華發展工程有限公司」進行的紀律聆訊，已押後至另行通知。
就宏泰消防的聆訊，委員會接納雙方申請，押後以便進一步準備。至於中華發展的聆訊，因控方需要更多時間處理案件，在涉事承辦商一方不反對下，亦獲接納押後。
獨立調查委員會聽證會早前透露，其中一間承辦商未有到場檢查卻多次提交消防裝置關閉通知書，另一間則知悉消防泵總電掣被關上但未有上報。消防處表示押後可讓雙方有更多準備時間。
